title: Report
description: The judged outcome of one run.

caveats.description:
Statements that must accompany any presentation of these results, such
as that survived mutants are not proven non-equivalent.

exit_code.description: Process exit code the run reported.

verdicts.description: One verdict per manifest mutant, in manifest order.

Location.description: A position in the target file.

column.description:
Character offset within the line, 0-indexed, matching the parser the
Python pack uses.

detail.description:
One-line summary for display only, such as `3 failed`. Not machine
readable: counts live in the results document under the same `run_id`.

file.description: Target file, POSIX-style and relative to the project root.

label.description: Refinement of the verdict, for example `killed_by_error`.

location.description: Position of the mutation, when the pack reported one.

mutant_id.description: The manifest mutant this verdict is about.

verdict.description: What the suite did to this mutant.

RunMeta.description: Who produced this report, from what, and when.

decision_rules_version.description: Version of the decision rules used, so verdicts stay attributable.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes at run time.

observed_revision.description: Source revision observed at run time, or absent when unavailable.

project.description: Project root, as given on the command line.

run_id.description: Identifier shared with the run directory and the results document.

tremula_version.description: Version of the tremula core that judged this run.

Score.description:
Aggregate counts over one run. Every field is a plain count of `verdicts`,
broken out per category because the exit code depends on which kind of
exclusion occurred.

killed.description: Mutants the suite detected, including those that timed out.

runtime_error.description: Attempts that could not produce a judgement.

survived.description: Mutants the suite ran but did not detect.

timeout.description: Subset of `killed` that timed out rather than failing a test.

Span.description:
A half-open byte range over a file's raw bytes: `[start_byte, end_byte)`.
That `start_byte` is below `end_byte` is a validation rule, not a schema
constraint.

Verdict.description: What the existing test suite did to a mutant.

oneOf.description: The suite ran and did not detect the mutant.

The suite exceeded its time limit under this mutant, counted as
detected.
The attempt could not produce a judgement.
The mutation was never applied, which indicates an adapter defect.
The mutant was scheduled but never executed.
The mutant was deliberately not executed.
